02 — Why CMAX

Not a gym floor.
A coaching room.

01

Private, not packed

A private personal training facility — no queues for kit, no crowds, no waiting around. Your session is yours.

02

A coach with you, every session

Every conversation shapes what you believe you are capable of. Coaches Blair and Colin lead a team that knows your name and your numbers.

03

A community, not a membership

Members make real friendships here — fist bumps, shared lifts, people who notice when you are not there.

04

Progress you can measure

Strength, fitness, body and mindset — tracked and pushed forward, session after session, week after week.
